labels.text: section 4974(a): 25 percent of the shortfall between the minimum required distribution and the actual amount distributed

25 percent — the current pinned text of section 4974(a). SECURE 2.0 Act of 2022 reduced this rate from 50 percent to 25 percent effective for taxable years beginning after December 29, 2022; this package's pinned notes for section 4974 were not checked at coverage-start precision for that boundary, so 1974-09-02 (ERISA's enactment, which created section 4974) is used as an unverified coverage-start boundary — the RATE ITSELF (25 percent) is the pinned current text; the pre-2023 50 percent rate for an earlier taxable year is NOT modelled (SOURCE_GAP for that period).
